name: metamodel.addType
title: Add type
summary: Add an element type to the metamodel; only the metamodel file that gets it changes, line by line.
details: The type is added at the end of `types` in the first metamodel file by name that has the list, else at the end of the first file, where the list is created (SR-236 AK4). Every other line of the file stays as it was, with its comment and line ending (SR-236 AK3); no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036). Without `key`, the key is made from the name: lower case, ä, ö, ü and ß as ae, oe, ue and ss, every run of other characters one hyphen (SR-236 AK6); it is fixed afterwards (D-043). A type that extends no other type gets the property with the meaning `title` as a required property, when the metamodel has one (SR-237 AK1). The metamodel files are read again before the change, and the metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). The next command of the same process uses the new metamodel (SR-236 AK9). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason key-required when no key is given and the one made from the name is empty (a name without letters or digits), does not start with a letter, is longer than 64 characters or is another type's key (details.key); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another type has the name (in Unicode normal form NFC) or the prefix (details.field, details.type); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error (such as a key that is already defined or an unknown type in `extends`); workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel; file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the list `types` of the file is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line) or is no list; workspace.read-only when the metamodel repository is not on this machine (details.repository); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed the file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

name.description: Display name of the type; no other type may have it.

prefix.description: Prefix of the short IDs of its elements, e.g. SR (D-017); no other type may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of the type (D-043). Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

extends.description: Key of the type it extends; its properties, required properties and statuses are inherited (SR-012 AK2).

abstract.description: No elements of the type can be created; it is only extended (SR-012 AK4).

type.title: Type
type.description: The definition as written to the file.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4), such as elements whose type was unknown before.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3).

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
